learning_checkpoint.prompt: Why do 21 alerted scenarios produce 23 active cases, and why should a legitimate stale-link alert remain a false positive even though the rule matched?
learning_checkpoint.ai_reference_answer: A scenario may meet more than one rule, so scenario-level accuracy and case-level workload use different denominators. The oracle business activity is benign despite matching telemetry; rule conformance does not establish malicious intent. A late correction still consumed initial analyst review work.
